atoms.b: Carbohydrates are foods that give us the most ((++energy ideas)). They can be found in foods like bread, rice, ((++pasta sweets)) and potatoes. Because they give us a lot of energy, we need to eat ((++more less)) carbohydrates than any other food group.

instruction.text: Are these statements true or false?

atoms.a: Carbohydrates are our main source of energy.
Carrots, beef and cheese are rich in carbohydrates.
We need to eat more carbohydrates than other food groups.
Carbohydrates can be found in potatoes, pasta and bread.

atoms.b: Fruits and vegetables make up the layer above ((++carbohydrates protein)) on the food pyramid. Fruits and vegetables help us to digest our food. They also contain lots of ((++vitamins bugs)) and ((++minerals rocks)), which help keep our immune system strong.

instruction.text: Connect the foods that fit into the fruits and vegetables group.

wrong.text: Although potatoes are vegetables, they don’t fit into this food group, because they are not rich in vitamins and minerals. They provide us with starch like carbohydrates.
